mapper.select: SELECT menu_items.id, menu_items.name, menu_items.price, menu_items.availability_status AS availabilityStatus FROM menu_items WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND id=#{menuItemId} AND availability_status='ACTIVE'

SELECT option_values.id, option_groups.id AS groupId, option_groups.name AS groupName, option_values.name, option_values.extra_price AS extraPrice FROM menu_item_option_groups INNER JOIN option_groups ON option_groups.id=menu_item_option_groups.option_group_id INNER JOIN option_values ON option_values.option_group_id=option_groups.id WHERE menu_item_option_groups.store_id=#{storeId} AND menu_item_option_groups.menu_item_id=#{menuItemId} AND option_groups.status='ACTIVE' AND option_values.status='ACTIVE' AND option_values.id IN #{id}

SELECT option_groups.id, option_groups.min_select AS minSelect, option_groups.max_select AS maxSelect FROM menu_item_option_groups INNER JOIN option_groups ON option_groups.id = menu_item_option_groups.option_group_id WHERE menu_item_option_groups.store_id = #{storeId} AND menu_item_option_groups.menu_item_id = #{menuItemId} AND option_groups.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT public_id AS publicId, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, payable_amount AS payableAmount FROM orders WHERE table_session_id = #{sessionId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT order_items.id, order_items.quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_item_cancellation_requests.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') THEN order_item_cancellation_requests.requested_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reservedCancellationQuantity, table_sessions.status AS sessionStatus FROM order_items INNER JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id = orders.table_session_id LEFT JOIN order_item_cancellation_requests ON order_item_cancellation_requests.order_item_id = order_items.id WHERE orders.table_session_id = #{sessionId} AND order_items.public_id = #{orderItemPublicId} GROUP BY order_items.id, order_items.quantity, table_sessions.status FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item_cancellation_requests (public_id, order_item_id, created_by_account_id, created_by_name, idempotency_key, requested_quantity, reason, status, is_remade, resolved_by, resolved_by_name, resolved_at) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{orderItemId}, NULL, NULL, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestedQuantity}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', FALSE, NULL, NULL, NULL)

INSERT INTO orders ( public_id, table_session_id, created_by_account_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, order_number, original_amount, payable_amount, note ) VALUES ( #{publicId}, #{sessionId}, NULL, #{idempotencyKey}, #{fingerprint}, #{orderNumber}, #{amount}, #{amount}, #{note} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( public_id, order_id, menu_item_id, item_name, unit_price, options_amount, quantity, prepared_quantity, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{publicId}, #{orderId}, #{menuItemId}, #{itemName}, #{unitPrice}, #{optionsAmount}, #{quantity}, 0, #{totalAmount} )

INSERT INTO order_item_options ( order_item_id, option_value_id, option_group_name, option_name, unit_price, quantity_per_item, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{optionValueId}, #{groupName}, #{optionName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount} )
